title: CoachTomAsh Academy Starter Library | 10 sessions
description: 10 editable youth academy sessions and 30 animated diagram practices; designed as adaptable starting points.

drills.name: U13 | 4v2 Rondo | scan before receiving
drills.objective: Receive with awareness of pressure; secure the first action and find the next connection.
drills.organisation: 4 outside v 2 inside; for 12 players run two identical grids. One ball in each; rotate defenders frequently.
drills.constraints: One or two touches by invitation, not a blanket rule; defenders earn a point for a controlled regain.
drills.coaching: Scan before the ball arrives; open body where possible; support both sides of the ball; disguise the next pass.
drills.progressions: Increase defender starting proximity; regress to 4v1 or a larger grid.
drills.success: Observe scanning before first touch and the number of purposeful support angles.

drills.name: U13 | 4v4+3 | retain and switch
drills.objective: Keep possession with a purpose, using neutral support to switch away from pressure.
drills.organisation: 4v4 with 3 neutral players supporting the team in possession. One football, extras nearby; rotate neutrals.
drills.constraints: Award a point for moving possession from one wide channel to the other under control.
drills.coaching: Find different supporting lines; receive on a half-turn; recognise when to draw pressure and release away from it.
drills.progressions: Reduce neutral support to 2; regress with one extra neutral or wider channels.
drills.success: Players identify when to secure versus when to switch and can explain their decision.

drills.name: U13 | 6v6 + 2 GK | build out
drills.objective: Build from goalkeeper with patience before progressing through the middle or around a pressing line.
drills.organisation: 6 outfield v 6 outfield plus 2 goalkeepers; half pitch with two full goals and marked build zones.
drills.constraints: Restart from GK; opposing team presses from a realistic trigger. A goal only counts after controlled build into middle third.
drills.coaching: GK and CB create angles; midfielders offer different heights; play away from a locked side; manage the what-if.
drills.progressions: Opposition begins higher; regress with free GK or a temporary +1 for building team.
drills.success: Count controlled exits and whether the next pass progresses with support behind it.

drills.name: U14 | 3v1 | receive to turn or connect
drills.objective: Receive behind pressure or use a supporting player to access the next zone.
drills.organisation: Three attackers against one defender in a split rectangle. Rotate defender every 60-90 seconds; duplicate stations for bigger groups.
drills.constraints: A point for receiving or passing into the end zone while retaining control.
drills.coaching: Check shoulders; show on different lines; play on back foot; recognise when to set and spin instead of forcing a turn.
drills.progressions: Add a second defender on rotation; regress by widening the area.
drills.success: Observe purposeful forwards actions and decision quality under pressure.

drills.name: U14 | 4v4+2 | connect through middle
drills.objective: Connect through central players to break an opposition line.
drills.organisation: 4v4 plus 2 neutral midfield players in a directional pitch split into thirds. Teams attack opposite ends.
drills.constraints: A point for entering final third through a pass or carry; neutrals support possession only.
drills.coaching: Adjust height and width; create third-player angles; carry to commit; choose the right moment to accelerate play.
drills.progressions: Limit central neutral time on ball; regress by giving a central neutral a safe zone.
drills.success: Different players break a line by carrying, passing or a combination.

drills.name: U14 | 7v7 | progressive entries to goal
drills.objective: Progress through and beyond a midfield line with support for the next action.
drills.organisation: 7v7 including goalkeepers where available; two full goals. Mark optional central channels to guide observation.
drills.constraints: Normal goals count; extra point for controlled progression through a defensive line before scoring.
drills.coaching: Stretch to create gaps; arrive on different lines; move in support of the line-breaking action; organise behind the ball.
drills.progressions: Defenders can lock one channel; regress with free first pass from GK.
drills.success: Record the decisions leading to controlled entries rather than only the number of goals.

drills.name: U15 | 3v2 | commit and release
drills.objective: Recognise when to carry to commit a defender and release a runner beyond the line.
drills.organisation: Three attackers v two defenders attacking one goal. Queue players for quick rotations, with extra defenders replacing after actions.
drills.constraints: Attacks last 8 seconds after entry; defenders counter to two mini goals when they regain.
drills.coaching: Carrier attacks front foot; off-ball players threaten different channels; timing of pass matches timing of run.
drills.progressions: Start 2v2 then add recovering runner; regress with a wider playing area.
drills.success: Attackers choose pass, carry or combination according to defender response.

drills.name: U15 | 5v4 + GK | exploit the spare player
drills.objective: Create and exploit a free player before the opposition reorganises.
drills.organisation: Five attackers v four outfield defenders plus goalkeeper. Work towards a full goal; rotate roles in short bouts.
drills.constraints: Defenders score by finding two mini goals at halfway; restart from coach immediately after each finish.
drills.coaching: Use third-player movement; stretch the last line; arrive at pace; prioritise finishing after a clear chance.
drills.progressions: Add a recovering defender; regress with a neutral attacker.
drills.success: Attacking team creates shots following deliberate overloads, rather than hopeful circulation.

drills.name: U15 | 8v8 | penetrate and finish
drills.objective: Carry the first advantage into a second action that breaks the last line and creates an attempt.
drills.organisation: 8v8 on reduced pitch with two full goals; teams nominate two players to monitor movements in behind.
drills.constraints: Normal game; bonus point when a goal follows a split pass or run behind the line.
drills.coaching: Opponent cues; double movements; ball-carrier head up; width and depth; secure counter-protection.
drills.progressions: Lower defensive block; regress by adding a wider channel to progress into.
drills.success: Review video-worthy moments of line-breaking and final actions.

drills.name: U16 | 5v3 | secure against an organised press
drills.objective: Keep possession with enough balance to play out through a target after drawing pressure.
drills.organisation: Five building players v three pressing players. Two exit gates at far end; coaches serve balls to start.
drills.constraints: Exit through either gate after at least one line-breaking action; pressers score by regaining and finishing in mini goal.
drills.coaching: Shape to receive; scan pressure and cover; use GK-type support; recognise when to recycle.
drills.progressions: Pressers start closer; regress with a neutral behind the ball.
drills.success: Build team selects a safe exit without losing the chance to progress.

drills.name: U16 | 6v5 + GK | play through or around
drills.objective: Use goalkeeper and defensive unit to connect with a forward player beyond the first pressing line.
drills.organisation: Six building outfield players plus GK v five pressing opponents on a half-pitch area. Use one full goal and two target gates.
drills.constraints: If pressing team regains, attack the full goal immediately; build team scores by receiving through an exit gate.
drills.coaching: Create back-three or back-two solutions as needed; midfield timing; blindside movements; verbal information.
drills.progressions: Remove a safe player; regress by delaying the first pressing action.
drills.success: How often does the ball arrive to a forward-facing teammate after build?

drills.name: U16 | 8v8 | build versus 4-4-2 press
drills.objective: Adapt team spacing and passing options to overcome a two-player first-line press.
drills.organisation: 8v8, two full goals. Out-of-possession side rehearses an adapted 4-4-2 press with two leading players.
drills.constraints: Play normally; reset selected attacks with GK to create repeated build scenarios.
drills.coaching: Patience to secure; progress once free player is found; winger/FB spacing; support behind play if ball is lost.
drills.progressions: Opposition starts with a locked flank; regress with free GK and one unopposed pass.
drills.success: Controlled progression from GK into attacking half with team shape intact.

drills.name: U15 | 3v2+recoverer | transition balance
drills.objective: Recognise defensive cover and immediate recovery runs when a team loses the ball.
drills.organisation: Three attackers attempt to score against two defenders, with one recovering defender starting behind play.
drills.constraints: On turnover the defending team counters through the opposite end gate; restart quickly to repeat.
drills.coaching: Nearest player delays; covering player protects central danger; recovery player tracks a realistic run.
drills.progressions: Release recoverer earlier; regress with a head start for the recovering player.
drills.success: The team protects central space before chasing the ball.

drills.name: U15 | 5v5+2 | protect behind possession
drills.objective: Organise two or three players to protect central transition spaces while attacking.
drills.organisation: 5v5 + 2 neutrals in possession, with two mini goals at either end. Mark a central recovery lane.
drills.constraints: If the defending team wins the ball, they have 6 seconds to attack; possession side must recover and protect.
drills.coaching: Rest-defence distances; stagger cover; when to counter-press versus delay; coach collective recovery.
drills.progressions: Reduce transition time; regress with a designated cover player.
drills.success: Repeated turnovers show balanced defensive positioning and coordinated reaction.

drills.name: U15 | 8v8 | attacking shape with rest defence
drills.objective: Attack with positive intent while keeping a defensively connected structure behind the ball.
drills.organisation: 8v8 with two full goals, restart from goalkeeper. Attackers play to score; defending group attacks immediately on regain.
drills.constraints: No mandatory freeze: award a bonus for regaining shape and preventing shot inside 8 seconds.
drills.coaching: Protect centre; support distances; recognise exposed spaces before passing; communicate the next duel.
drills.progressions: Give opponents a high outlet; regress with narrower field.
drills.success: Analyse number and quality of counterattack opportunities conceded.

drills.name: U16 | 4v4 | trigger and trap
drills.objective: Coordinate the first press and nearby covering actions after a clear trigger.
drills.organisation: 4v4 with directional targets; coach serves from one end to create backward-pass and wide-pass triggers.
drills.constraints: Team scoring by regain in the far half earns bonus; attackers can switch play to escape a locked side.
drills.coaching: Press at speed, arc run to block inside, second player jumps, third player provides cover.
drills.progressions: Remove pre-set trigger; regress by starting with a predictable pass.
drills.success: All pressing players react within two seconds of a shared cue.

drills.name: U16 | 7v6 | high press versus build
drills.objective: Lock the build to one side and compress space without leaving the centre exposed.
drills.organisation: Seven building players v six pressing players with two exit gates and one full goal. The pressing group works in units.
drills.constraints: Builders score via either gate; pressers score in full goal after regaining. Rotate units after 3-minute blocks.
drills.coaching: Show outside; lock one side; protect inside lanes; GK and back-line cues; track central rotations.
drills.progressions: Add GK as a free player; progress by allowing wide switch after two passes.
drills.success: Quality of regains and whether build team escapes through central spaces.

drills.name: U16 | 8v8 | 4-4-2 pressing game
drills.objective: Rehearse coordinated pressing actions from two front players through midfield support.
drills.organisation: 8v8 with two full goals. One team starts in an adapted 4-4-2 pressing shape in its out-of-possession moments.
drills.constraints: Start multiple actions from opposition GK; otherwise play normally. Reward goals within 10 seconds of high regains.
drills.coaching: Distance between units; show to one side; outside shoulder angle; cover and compact on next pass.
drills.progressions: Opposition may use neutral to create a spare player; regress by using guided restart positions.
drills.success: Regains come from collective connection rather than individual sprints.

drills.name: U13 | 1v1 | close, slow, make contact
drills.objective: Approach at speed, slow to control the duel and make contact on a safe side.
drills.organisation: Four small grids running simultaneously, each with attacker, defender and an end target. Rotate from a group of 10.
drills.constraints: Attacker crosses end line; defender scores by winning or forcing play away from target.
drills.coaching: Arrive quickly then decelerate; low balanced stance; protect inside; time first contact; no reckless diving.
drills.progressions: Give attacker 2-second head start; regress by narrowing area.
drills.success: Defender controls space and direction even without winning the ball.

drills.name: U13 | 2v2 | nearest pressure and cover
drills.objective: Recognise roles of first and second defender when facing a ball carrier and supporting runner.
drills.organisation: 2v2 continuous bouts with an end target at each end. Rotate teams quickly from waiting pairs.
drills.constraints: Goals after regains count double to promote immediate support when transition occurs.
drills.coaching: First defender engages; second defender provides cover and can take over; communicate switch; stay compact.
drills.progressions: Add an overlap runner after three seconds; regress by reducing attacking width.
drills.success: Both defenders respond together to passes and forward carries.

drills.name: U13 | 4v4 | defend the central gate
drills.objective: Protect the most dangerous central route while still applying pressure to the ball.
drills.organisation: 4v4 to mini goals. Mark a central scoring gate and two wide gates. Rotate extra players as needed.
drills.constraints: Central gate worth two; wide gate worth one. Frequent restarts create repeated defending moments.
drills.coaching: First pressure controls direction; cover central; communicate who steps; recover after beaten.
drills.progressions: Open extra wide gate; regress with one spare defender.
drills.success: Teams reduce central entries and recover quickly after a duel is lost.

drills.name: U14 | 2v1 | transition to finish
drills.objective: Recognise whether to drive forward, combine or finish in a two-player break.
drills.organisation: 2 attackers v 1 defender attacking a full goal with GK if available. Queue rotations at start zone.
drills.constraints: Maximum 8-second attack; defender earns point by delaying beyond time limit or winning the ball.
drills.coaching: First touch forward; carrier commits defender; partner runs to create a passing angle; finish decisively.
drills.progressions: Add recovering defender; regress by starting defender further away.
drills.success: Number of positive actions that lead to shots, not just goals.

drills.name: U14 | 4v4+2 | win and go
drills.objective: Exploit opponent imbalance during first seconds after regaining possession.
drills.organisation: 4v4 with two neutral support players and two end goals. Neutrals support team in possession.
drills.constraints: Goals within 7 seconds of a regain worth two; otherwise normal game.
drills.coaching: First forward look; support runs beyond; recognise outnumbered moment; protect ball if immediate counter is blocked.
drills.progressions: Reduce to 5 seconds; regress with extra neutral for regaining team.
drills.success: Players identify when direct transition is advantageous and when to secure.

drills.name: U14 | 6v6 | regain, connect, attack
drills.objective: Turn regains into connected attacks while maintaining cover in case of another turnover.
drills.organisation: 6v6 directional game to full goals. Coaches restart from varied areas to create different transitions.
drills.constraints: Bonus when regaining side produces controlled shot inside 10 seconds.
drills.coaching: Immediate scan; first pass into open space; time forward run; protect central space behind ball.
drills.progressions: Opposition gets a recovery player; regress with wider pitch.
drills.success: Attacking intent improves without increasing careless turnovers.

drills.name: U15 | 5v2 | reaction after loss
drills.objective: React intelligently to a turnover and apply immediate pressure if the ball is still contestable.
drills.organisation: 5v2 possession with rapid replacement: on regain, team losing possession has 3 seconds to win back.
drills.constraints: Regaining team earns a point for exiting through a gate; previous possession team earns point if immediate win back.
drills.coaching: Nearest presses; second player screens inside; teammates support compactly; know when the ball is gone.
drills.progressions: Turn into 5v3; regress with a larger area.
drills.success: Players distinguish realistic counter-pressing moments from needed recovery runs.

drills.name: U15 | 7v7 | pressing unit game
drills.objective: Coordinate first line, midfield and supporting players when opposition attempts to build.
drills.organisation: 7v7 to full goals with repeated GK restarts and brief live segments.
drills.constraints: Bonus score for goal scored within 10 seconds of a high regain.
drills.coaching: Share trigger, force outside, secure cover, recognise pressing distance; recover when bypassed.
drills.progressions: Allow a free neutral for building side; regress with guided shape reset.
drills.success: Team moves together rather than leaving gaps between individual pressers.

drills.name: U15 | 8v8 | opposition scenario and set restarts
drills.objective: Apply planned press cues and first transition action in a realistic game.
drills.organisation: 8v8 game with 3-4 rehearsed restart scenarios, including wide build, central turnover and GK possession.
drills.constraints: Normal goals; review one successful coordinated regain and one successful recovery each block.
drills.coaching: Communicate trigger; press through correct angle; cover at the back; protect emotional control after beaten.
drills.progressions: Change opponent build shape halfway; regress with coach-freeze only at a genuine learning moment.
drills.success: Players can explain why they pressed or recovered in three specific moments.

drills.name: U14 | 4v2 | information before receiving
drills.objective: Recognise and communicate the most useful information before a teammate receives.
drills.organisation: 4v2 rondo; give each player a clear receiving task. Duplicate for full group, frequent rotations.
drills.constraints: Positive score for successful continuation after receiving information; do not stop play for missing calls.
drills.coaching: Scan; give early concise cues; make body language visible; take ownership after mistakes.
drills.progressions: Narrow grid or vary defender entry; regress with 4v1.
drills.success: Quality and timing of information improve, not simply call frequency.

drills.name: U14 | 5v5 | solve the press together
drills.objective: Organise shared support and calm decisions when the opposition becomes aggressive.
drills.organisation: 5v5 with two end targets; pressers can win immediate score after forcing a backward pass.
drills.constraints: Possession team earns bonus for escaping pressure and progressing with at least two players connected.
drills.coaching: Help before receiving; positive body language; accurate cues; patient restart after an error.
drills.progressions: Introduce pressing trigger; regress by adding neutral support.
drills.success: Team keeps intent and concentration after successive turnovers.

drills.name: U14 | 7v7 | reset and refocus
drills.objective: Translate composure and clear communication into better game choices after setbacks.
drills.organisation: 7v7 game with coaching interruptions limited to natural breaks. Coach announces occasional scenario changes.
drills.constraints: Normal goals; team captains call a 10-second reset after conceding or a major turnover.
drills.coaching: Recognise the moment; send clear message; confirm group roles; act on next restart.
drills.progressions: Add time-pressure scenario; regress with a scripted restart.
drills.success: Players self-organise and maintain decision quality during challenge.
